description.value: Anytime the stun baton deals damage, the attack target must make an Endurance check: DV = 10+dmg (max DV: 16). On failure, the target's MOVE is reduced by 4 and all actions they attempt suffer a -4 penalty until the end of their next turn. An actor can only suffer from one instance of this effect during each of their turns.
Light version of an Armorjack. No armor penalty.
Light version of an Armorjack for your head. No armor penalty.
